title: 能力折旧表 / Capability Depreciation
author: zhr15
description: 模型换代时，装过的 skill / 插件不会报错，只会悄悄变差。这个 skill 给每个资产一个能力指纹，用 golden set 回归出通过率矩阵，指纹没变而通过率掉了才判退化；并回答三个问题：能力退化了吗、新装的好不好用、符不符合你本人。支持 DSH 插件 / WorkBuddy / Claude Code / Codex 多宿主。
description_zh: 模型换代时，装过的 skill / 插件不会报错，只会悄悄变差。这个 skill 给每个资产一个能力指纹，用 golden set 回归出通过率矩阵，指纹没变而通过率掉了才判退化；并回答三个问题：能力退化了吗、新装的好不好用、符不符合你本人。支持 DSH 插件 / WorkBuddy / Claude Code / Codex 多宿主。
description_en: Installed skills and plugins do not throw errors when the model changes — they just quietly get worse. This skill fingerprints each asset, replays a golden set to build a pass-rate matrix, and only calls it degradation when the fingerprint is unchanged and the pass rate drops. Answers three questions: did capability degrade, is a new asset worth it, and does it fit you.
